== Notes ==
* This skill is mechanically the same as a [[shadow step]].
* This skill (and its PvE version) is the only shadow step skill able to move the user to any target, regardless of whether the target is a foe or ally.

== Trivia ==
*The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Ride the Lightning/Skill history|PvE skill history]] and [[Ride the Lightning (PvP)/Skill history|PvP skill history]] for details.
